items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The New Orleans musicians in that particular band, there was Ram and George Foster, you...well, practically everybody except Alex Hill.

ctx.x: That's right. I think Frank would bring his guitar once in a while, when it wasn't in hock. Which it's true, a lot of times I'd just be playing my alto saxophone because my soprano would be in hock, you see. But I never hocked my alto, because I had to have it.
The New Orleans musicians in that particular band, there was Ram and George Foster, you...well, practically everybody except Alex Hill.
